text: GOOOOOAAAAAALLLL! CHELSEA ARE BACK IN IT! Nkunku with a debut Premier League goal! It's game on at Molineux again as Sterling gets down the right to cross, and Nkunku guides a glancing header into the bottom-left corner when left unmarked.

GOOOOOOOAAAAAAAAALLLLLLL! LEMINA PUTS WOLVES AHEAD! Wolves have caused Chelsea so many problems from set-pieces, and they finally take advantage of one to go 1-0 up! Sarabia swings his deep corner-kick towards the far post, where Lemina glances a deft header into the bottom-left corner! Molineux erupts!

narrative_context: sudden early moment with little build-up
text: His pass across the box finds Broja in space near the penalty spot, and he looks destined to open the scoring.
OVER! Wolves miss their best chance of the half! Kilman lifts a great ball over the top of the Chelsea defence, with Petrovic unsure whether to come out or stay on his line.
He has a chance to square to Jackson but opts to shoot himself, and Sa spreads himself to make a vital one-on-one save! He had to make up for his earlier error.
It's their longest scoring streak at Molineux in the top flight since a run of 16 between August and March in 1969-70, but they'll need to step things up to keep it going here.
MISSED CHANCE! Sterling pops up on the right this time, sending a looping cross towards Jackson at the far post.
Save! The corner runs too long but Toti keeps it alive at the back to find Lemina.
OVER! Sterling beats the wall with his free-kick, but he can't get enough dip on the shot as it flies over Sa's crossbar.

narrative_context: sudden late moment with little build-up
text: Madueke cuts inside from the right, but instead of looking for a team-mate, he blasts a poor effort well wide of Sa's right-hand post.
His scuffed shot almost puts Hwang in on goal, but he's forced wide by Petrovic and can only win a corner.
